The short answer

King Khalid International Airport (RUH)

Your Riyadh airport transfer, step by step

RUH is about 35 km north of central Riyadh — ~30 min on a clear road. Here is how an arrival and a departure work.

  1. 1

    Book ahead

    Send your flight number, landing time and hotel. Your fare is agreed before you travel.

  2. 2

    Land at RUH

    Clear immigration and collect your bags at King Khalid International Airport.

  3. 3

    Meet your driver

    Your driver's details are shared on WhatsApp before pickup so you can contact them directly.

  4. 4

    Load luggage

    Vehicle size is matched to your passengers and bags when you book — no repacking at the kerb.

  5. 5

    Private drive

    About 35 km to central Riyadh — ~30 min off-peak, longer at commuter peaks.

  6. 6

    Hotel or meeting

    Dropped at the right entrance — Olaya, KAFD, the Diplomatic Quarter or anywhere in Riyadh.

Travelling light and alone? The Riyadh Metro Yellow Line links the airport with KAFD. With luggage, family, or a fixed first meeting, a car to the door is simpler.

Plan your timing

How traffic and timing work in Riyadh

Riyadh is spread out and car-centred. Drive times vary with the hour and the season, so here is what moves them — rather than a number that only holds on an empty road.

01

Airport runs

RUH is 35 km from central Riyadh — ~30 min on a clear road. The northern approach roads slow down sharply at weekday commuter peaks, so departure pickups are set with a buffer rather than the clear-road time.

02

Business districts

KAFD, Olaya and King Fahd Road carry the heaviest office traffic in the morning and late afternoon. Meeting-to-meeting hops across these districts are short in distance but can be slow in time — the main reason people book a driver by the hour.

03

Evenings & weekends

Riyadh's leisure traffic runs late. Diriyah dinners, malls and the Boulevard zones in Hittin get busiest after sunset and on Thursday and Friday nights — book a fixed return time instead of searching for a car at closing.

04

Event periods

Large exhibitions and Riyadh Season nights concentrate thousands of arrivals at one venue. Allow extra time and agree a specific pickup point in advance — venue drop-off lanes change with each event.

05

Ramadan

Daytime roads are quieter; traffic peaks around iftar and late into the night. Tell us if your trip falls in Ramadan and we plan the pickup time accordingly.

06

Long-distance trips

Intercity drives from Riyadh are long — Dammam is the shortest major corridor. Early starts beat the city traffic out; the driver stops for prayer, fuel and rest on request.

For international visitors

Getting around Riyadh: what visitors usually ask

How do I get from Riyadh airport to my hotel?

Pre-book a private transfer from King Khalid International Airport (RUH): send your flight number and hotel, agree the fare, and your driver's contact details arrive on WhatsApp before pickup. It is about 35 km to central Riyadh. If you travel light, the Riyadh Metro's Yellow Line also connects the airport with KAFD.

Is a private driver better than a standard taxi or ride-hailing?

For one short hop in the city, any car works. A pre-booked private driver makes the difference when the fare must be fixed in advance, when you carry luggage, when a car must wait, or when a company needs a receipt or invoice.

Can I travel from Riyadh to other cities by car?

Yes — door to door. Dammam is the shortest major corridor; Makkah, Madinah and Jeddah are full-day drives where a flight is faster but a car carries the whole family and luggage for one fare. The route list below shows real distances for every corridor.

What if I have a lot of luggage?

Tell us the number of large cases when you book. Sedans suit one or two cases each; full-size SUVs, vans and coasters handle families, golf bags and exhibition kit.

What happens after I send a request?

We reply on WhatsApp to confirm the details, agree one fixed fare, then share your driver's details before pickup. Plans change? Cancellation is free up to 24 hours before pickup.

Which language do the drivers speak?

Drivers in our Riyadh network speak English and Arabic. Hotel names and addresses in either language are fine — a map pin on WhatsApp is the most reliable.

FAQ

Riyadh transport questions, answered

Short answers to what travellers ask before booking. Anything else — message us.

Ask on WhatsApp

How do I get from King Khalid International Airport (RUH) to my hotel in Riyadh?

Book a private transfer before you fly. Send your flight number, landing time and hotel on WhatsApp, agree the fare, and your driver's contact details are shared before pickup. RUH is about 35 km from central Riyadh — ~30 min on a clear road, longer at weekday commuter peaks.

How long does it take from RUH to KAFD or Olaya?

RUH to the KAFD and Olaya hotel area is about 40 km — ~35 min with clear roads. Morning and late-afternoon commuter peaks can add significantly to that, so departure pickups are planned with a buffer.

Can I hire a private driver in Riyadh for several hours or a full day?

Yes. Hourly and full-day hire keeps the same car and driver with you, waiting between stops — the usual choice for a business day across KAFD, Olaya and the Diplomatic Quarter, or a shopping and sightseeing day. Send your date, start time and hours needed for a fixed quote.

How much does a private transfer in Riyadh cost?

The fare depends on the route, vehicle, date and waiting time, so it is quoted per trip and agreed before you book — one fixed price, no meter and no surge, even if the traffic is heavy.

What information do I need to send for a quote?

Pickup and drop-off (a hotel name or map pin is ideal), date and time, number of passengers, number of large bags, and your flight number for airport trips. For hourly hire, add the hours and a rough list of stops.

Can I travel from Riyadh to Dammam, Makkah or Jeddah by private car?

Yes, door to door. Riyadh to Dammam is about 410 km (~4 hr), Riyadh to Makkah about 870 km (~8 hr) and Riyadh to Jeddah about 950 km (~9 hr). Rest and prayer stops are made on request.

Can I go from Riyadh to Bahrain, Qatar, the UAE or Kuwait by car?

Yes. Pre-booked cross-border cars run from Riyadh to Manama (about 450 km via the King Fahd Causeway), Doha, Abu Dhabi, Dubai and Kuwait City. Passengers need their own valid passports and any visas required for entry.

Which vehicle should I book for a family with luggage?

A full-size SUV fits up to seven passengers with room for several large cases; a VIP van suits a family or group that wants extra luggage space. A sedan is right for one to three people with normal luggage.

How do I pay, and can I get a receipt?

Pay the driver in cash or pay by bank transfer. An electronic receipt is available on request — useful for expense claims.

Can companies get an invoice for Riyadh transportation?

Yes. Corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company. Email us your company details and trip list for a written quote before booking.

Can I cancel or change my booking?

Yes. Cancellation is free up to 24 hours before pickup, and you can change times or addresses by WhatsApp.

Do the drivers speak English?

Yes. Drivers in our Riyadh partner network speak English and Arabic, and trips run 24 hours a day.
